title: Dua wanita ditahan, kayu gaharu bernilai RM3.47 juta dirampas
summary: PASIR MAS: Dua wanita ditahan selepas polis merampas kayu gaharu bernilai RM3.47 juta dalam serbuan di sebuah rumah di Kampung Baharu Cherang Hangus, Chicha Tinggi, di sini, jam 5 petang semalam.

title_en: Two women arrested, 3.47 million palm trees seized
summary_en: PASIR MAS: Two women were arrested after police seized 3.47 million ringgit worth of tobacco timber in a raid on a house at Kampung Baharu Cherang Hangus, Chicha Tinggi, here, yesterday at 5 pm.

title: Pregnant woman with 18 criminal records caught ferrying undocumented migrants
summary: TUMPAT: A 35-year-old woman who is three months pregnant and had been ferrying undocumented migrants from the Kelantan border to various destinations for several months was arrested today.
